purpose: Limely için logo, maskot ve ekran konseptleri; uygulama koduna uygulanmadı.

prompts.brand:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create a polished LANDSCAPE identity concept board for a Turkish nutrition and dietitian app named EXACTLY "limely". Two supplied images are STYLE REFERENCES: first is a tiny hand-drawn lemon with leaf, second is a friendly flat green round lime creature with tiny hands, dot eyes and a yellow citrus wedge on its lower body. Develop an original cohesive LIME identity inspired by this friendly simplicity. Do not copy the source pixel-for-pixel. This is a lime brand, so the overall fruit and mascot are GREEN, with only small yellow inner flesh accents.
Board background warm offwhite #F8FAF2, typography dark forest #203B2F, primary lime #C9E879, mascot body soft orchard green #83B977, leaf #3D7756, citrus flesh #F5D96A, white pith. Flat vector-friendly artwork, smooth organic shapes, subtle imperfect outline only where needed, absolutely no 3D, photorealism, drop shadows or shine. Large clean presentation with ample whitespace.
Top left small label "LIMELY · MARKA YÖNÜ". Main left section: a large clean brand lockup, simple round lime fruit/cut-fruit symbol with single dark leaf, then wordmark "limely" in bold lowercase friendly rounded custom sans lettering. The non-character lime symbol must remain readable at tiny size. Below it exact short line "Kendine iyi gelen küçük adımlar." Below show one rounded-square mobile app icon containing the same simplified lime symbol, and one dark-green monochrome version.
Right main section: a large lime MASCOT derived from the supplied second reference, compact round sage green body, two small dark dot eyes, a very small curved smile, tiny arms and feet, one top leaf, lower-right body contains a friendly visible citrus wedge with cream pith and 3-4 yellow segments, contrasting dark-green rind. One hand raised in welcome. Adult-friendly gentle companion, not babyish, not emoji, not monster, no large eyes or teeth.
Lower middle: four smaller consistent mascot poses in a neat row, each the exact same character proportions and colors: waving, tiny wink, holding a small glass of water, gentle celebration with hands up. Label them exactly "Merhaba", "Göz kırpma", "Su molası", "Küçük kutlama". Keep no extra scene objects beyond a glass in the water pose.
Bottom: a row of 6 clean solid swatches with exact hex labels "#F8FAF2", "#203B2F", "#C9E879", "#83B977", "#F5D96A", "#EAF3DE". Tiny footer "Logo + maskot konsepti". No trademark claims, no availability claims, no additional brand names. All letters must be spelled correctly.
prompts.mobile:
Use case: ui-mockup, screenshot rebranding and palette edit.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: an existing Turkish nutrition client mobile screen. Input image 2 is the APPROVED STYLE REFERENCE for the Limely identity (lime fruit logo, green lime mascot, warm offwhite palette). Rebrand and recolor the first screenshot into a polished "limely" mobile dashboard. Preserve its exact screen layout, geometry, friendly rounded Fredoka headings/Figtree body style, 7 weekday tiles, calorie circle, exactly 8 water glasses (3 full, 5 empty), appointment card, partially visible breakfast meal card and all 5 bottom tabs. Change the name "Tazeli" to "Limely" and the tiny apricot logo to the simple green LIME fruit logo from reference 2. No new feature panels. Single portrait screen, flat, no device hardware, no presentation margins, no exterior caption.
Palette: overall background #F8FAF2 (very pale warm green ivory), white cards, primary dark text #203B2F, secondary text #627365, main lime accent #C9E879, dark green #3D7756, soft sage #83B977, lemon-yellow minor accent #F5D96A, soft green surfaces #EAF3DE. Never use white text on pale lime; use dark forest text. The selected weekday is deep forest green with white date; completed-day underlines sage. Calorie progress arc rich lime green (distinct from its pale green track). The water glasses have dark forest thin outlines with sage green fill and cream highlights. Water-card very pale green gradient/tint. "+ Bardak" button is lime #C9E879 with dark text #203B2F and subtle darker green lower edge. Avatar lime. All icons dark green/sage and selected home tab lime-tinted. Meal-completion check is white on darker green #3D7756.
Exact text and values from original: top "Limely · danışan", "Elif Yılmaz"; "Günaydın, Elif"; "1 / 6 öğün tamam". Week Pzt 23, Sal 24 selected, Çar 25, Per 26, Cum 27, Cmt 28, Paz 29. Circle "425" with "/ 1.495 kcal". Caption "Planlanan öğünleri işaretledikçe dolar." Water "Su", "3 / 8", minus button and "+ Bardak". Appointment "Sonraki görüşme", "27 Kasım Cuma, 18:30", "Online". "Planım", breakfast "08:00", "Kahvaltı", "425 kcal", "Yulaf ezmesi". Bottom "Bugün", "Ölçüm", "Mesaj", "Randevu", "Liste".
Keep everything legible, original generous rounded cards and soft shadows. No orange/brown original theme. No added tagline, no watermark. This is the original familiar screen in a cohesive Limely lime identity.
prompts.desktop:
Use case: ui-mockup, screenshot rebranding and palette edit.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: existing wide Turkish dietitian dashboard. Input image 2 is the STYLE REFERENCE for "limely" logo, lime mascot and palette.
Make one high-resolution wide landscape desktop dashboard mockup. Preserve source composition, sidebar width, navigation, appointments, overdue measurements, four top KPI cards, greeting and generous rounded cards. Keep warm rounded Fredoka headings and Figtree body lettering. Preserve screenshot aspect ratio and visible crop. Rebrand all visible product marks from Tazeli to lowercase "limely" with simple GREEN lime fruit logo from image 2. Remove the third-party demo strip above the application (not part of own product). Replace the large third-party sales banner's content with this Limely welcome content while retaining its position and broad geometry: small "LIMELY", heading "İyi alışkanlıklar, birlikte büyür.", description "Danışanlarının planını, görüşmelerini ve günlük ilerlemesini tek yerden takip et." Use a small welcoming lime mascot on the right side of this banner instead of contact phone/sales buttons. Do NOT include Briefikir, external sales text, phone numbers or supplier ads. Remove sidebar bottom demo-reset and supplier-sales button; show a discreet "Ayarlar" navigation link in that area. All other functional content remains in place.
Palette: background #F8FAF2, white sidebar and cards, main text #203B2F, muted #627365. Hero banner solid dark forest #203B2F, quiet organic shapes #365942, white heading and pale mint body text, mascot body #83B977 yellow inner citrus wedge #F5D96A. Sidebar selected "Gösterge" pale lime #EAF3DE with darkgreen label and lime indicator. Main "Yeni plan" button #C9E879 darkforest text. Green appointment "Başlat" buttons #C9E879 with darkforest text. Avatar and badge accents limited to sage, lime and soft yellow, rose for real alerts. Thin rounded green line icons, no colored glow, no neon.
Original content to preserve: "İyi çalışmalar, Defne", date "24 Kasım 2026 Salı", "Takvim", "Yeni plan". Sidebar "Gösterge", "Danışanlar", "Diyet planları", "Takvim", "Paket & tahsilat", "Mesajlar" badge 2, "Başvurular" badge 3, "Raporlar", "Danışan uygulaması", "Web sitesi", "Dyt. Defne Akarsu".
KPI: "Bugünkü görüşme" 5; "Aktif danışan" 16; "Bu ay tahsilat" "42.800,00 ₺"; "Bekleyen talep" 3. Main lower cards "Bugünkü görüşmeler" with existing appointments and names, and "7 gündür ölçüm yok" with existing people and 9 alert badge.
This is a realistic premium but friendly operational desktop product. Use mascot only once in welcome banner, tiny simple logo in sidebar, never scatter cartoon decorations into work tables. No external frame, no explanatory presentation text. Make all Turkish writing clear and natural.
prompts.onboarding:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished high-resolution LANDSCAPE board with THREE full-height Turkish mobile onboarding screen designs for the nutrition app "limely", neatly side by side with equal screen widths and gaps, no phone hardware frames. Input image 1 is the definitive STYLE REFERENCE for Limely logo, simple fruit symbol, round sage green lime mascot with leaf and yellow segmented wedge on lower body. Input image 2 is the STYLE REFERENCE for the application's dashboard typography, cards and color palette. Match this identity consistently. All THREE screens complete, uncropped, readable. Very minimal neutral exterior margin and tiny labels above each screen "Karşılama", "Hedef", "Seni tanıyalım". NO narration, motion arrows, trademark claims or extra marketing paragraphs outside screens.
Product colors: warm offwhite #F8FAF2, darkforest #203B2F, pale green #EAF3DE, lime #C9E879, character sage #83B977 with darkleaf #3D7756 and yellow flesh #F5D96A. White/palegreen cards, very subtle shadows, 24-28px rounded corners, rounded Fredoka-like bold headings, readable Figtree-like body. Large adult-friendly touch controls. Primary lime buttons always have dark green text, never white text. No fluorescent greens. Thin consistent darkgreen line icons, little ornament, intentional whitespace.
SCREEN 1, welcome: small centered simple lime logo plus lowercase wordmark "limely" at top. Large matching lime mascot in center, one arm raised mid-wave, small friendly smile and dots for eyes, leaf on top, citrus wedge on lower-right body. A soft palegreen circular backdrop behind it and 2 tiny citrus seed accents. Below it headline exact "Merhaba, ben Limely!" Body exact "Kendine iyi gelen küçük adımları birlikte atalım." Tiny reassuring note "Önce seni biraz tanıyalım." Large fullwidth lime button "Hadi başlayalım" at bottom. Under button small line "Zaten hesabın var mı? Giriş yap". Do not make login main focus. Mascot should look like a captured frame from a subtle wave animation, but this asset is static.
SCREEN 2, goal: top back arrow and slim 1/3 progress indicator, small fruit wordmark in header. Small lime mascot peeks near heading. Headline "Sana nasıl eşlik edelim?" Body "Hedefini birlikte belirleyelim." Four big white rounded options with quiet outline icons at left and selection circles at right: "Kilo vermek", "Kilo almak", "Kilomu korumak", "Daha dengeli beslenmek". Fourth option selected, pale lime fill with clear darkgreen check ring. Small optional note "Hedefin zamanla değişebilir." Bottom lime fullwidth button "Devam et".
SCREEN 3, profile: same top back and 2/3 progress indicator and logo. Small mascot holding a tape measure near headline. Heading "Seni biraz tanıyalım." Body "Başlangıcını sana göre hazırlayalım." White rounded inputs "Yaşın" example "28", "Boyun" example "170 cm", "Kilon" example "72 kg". These are clearly form values, not health recommendations. A short activity choice group labeled "Günün nasıl geçiyor?" with three pills "Çoğunlukla oturarak", "Biraz hareketli", "Çok hareketli"; middle selected. Small helper text "Bu bilgileri daha sonra değiştirebilirsin." Bottom lime button "Devam et".
No generated calorie targets, no invented weight-loss claims, no paywalls, no technical explanations, no loading screens. All three screens align button baselines and typography. Perfect Turkish spelling. Character must be the SAME lime in all screens, not a lemon or avocado, and preserve the distinctive segmented yellow citrus wedge.
